metadata.title: S&P 500 Executive Compensation Data
metadata.description: Executive compensation data for S&P 500 companies. 314 companies enriched with full NEO data from SEC EDGAR DEF 14A proxy filings.
sources: AFL-CIO Executive Paywatch 2025 (CEO totals, median pay, pay ratios)
notes: Total compensation from Summary Compensation Table in proxy statements
Component breakdowns: salary, bonus, stock awards, option awards, non-equity incentive, pension/NQDC, all other
Parser strips footnote references from values (e.g., 25,125,903(4) → 25,125,903)
Some companies may have partial component data where SCT format varies

companies.notes: Partnership structure. NEO compensation primarily through partnership distributions and carried interest, not reported in standard Summary Compensation Table. AFL-CIO total includes realized distributions.
